items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: Like I say, like this lady, Rosa Lopez. Her voice says, you say hear a voice? “No,” I just says “noises.”

ctx.x: He’s a corny one. Like I say, like this lady, Rosa Lopez. Her voice says, you say hear a voice? “No,” I just says “noises.”
